# axcl.engine

## 1. Index

- [axcl.engine.get_version](#axcl.engine.get_version): Get the AX Engine library version string.
- [axcl.engine.npu_reset](#axcl.engine.npu_reset): Reset the NPU hardware.
- [axcl.engine.init](#axcl.engine.init): Initialize the resources required by the engine runtime and specify the NPU working mode.
- [axcl.engine.get_vnpu_attr](#axcl.engine.get_vnpu_attr): Get the current NPU attribute.
- [axcl.engine.deinit](#axcl.engine.deinit): Release the resources held by the engine runtime.
- [axcl.engine.get_model_type](#axcl.engine.get_model_type): Get the model type by reading the model memory buffer.
- [axcl.engine.create_handle](#axcl.engine.create_handle): Create an inference engine handle and load the axmodel model data. The size of the axmodel file is the maximum CMM space occupied after the model is loaded.
- [axcl.engine.create_handle_v2](#axcl.engine.create_handle_v2): Create an inference engine handle with extra parameters. Same as AX_ENGINE_CreateHandle(), and additionally supports creating a handle from an encrypted model via AX_ENGINE_HANDLE_EXTRA_T.
- [axcl.engine.destroy_handle](#axcl.engine.destroy_handle): Destroy the inference engine handle and release all resources related to the model.
- [axcl.engine.get_io_info](#axcl.engine.get_io_info): Get the input/output information of the model loaded by the handle.
- [axcl.engine.get_group_io_info_count](#axcl.engine.get_group_io_info_count): Get the number of group IO information sets of the model.
- [axcl.engine.get_group_io_info](#axcl.engine.get_group_io_info): Get the IO information of the specified group.
- [axcl.engine.get_handle_model_type](#axcl.engine.get_handle_model_type): Get the model type of the model loaded by the handle.
- [axcl.engine.create_context](#axcl.engine.create_context): Create the default context required for graph execution and initialize graph resources.
- [axcl.engine.create_context_v2](#axcl.engine.create_context_v2): Create an additional context required for graph execution. Multiple contexts can be created from the same model handle, so multi-context tasks no longer require multiple handles.
- [axcl.engine.run_sync](#axcl.engine.run_sync): Run graph inference synchronously on the default context.
- [axcl.engine.run_sync_v2](#axcl.engine.run_sync_v2): Run graph inference synchronously on the specified context.
- [axcl.engine.run_group_io_sync](#axcl.engine.run_group_io_sync): Run group IO inference synchronously.
- [axcl.engine.set_affinity](#axcl.engine.set_affinity): Set the NPU core affinity of the model handle.
- [axcl.engine.get_affinity](#axcl.engine.get_affinity): Get the NPU core affinity of the model handle.
- [axcl.engine.get_cmm_usage](#axcl.engine.get_cmm_usage): Get the CMM memory usage of the model.
- [axcl.engine.get_model_tools_version](#axcl.engine.get_model_tools_version): Get the version of the Pulsar2 toolchain that compiled the model.

<br>

### 2.7. axcl.engine.create_handle


|---|---|---|
| data | int &#124; None | Device physical address of the model data (from<br>    `axcl.rt.mem_get_dev_addr` after copying the model to device memory). |
| data_size | int | Length of the model data in bytes. |

#### 2.7.3. Returns

- `handle`: *int* — Inference engine handle.
- `ret`: *int* — Success. Failure. Return error code.

#### 2.7.4. Note

Return type: `tuple[int, int]`.

<a id="axcl.engine.run_sync"></a>

### 2.16. axcl.engine.run_sync

Run graph inference synchronously on the default context.

#### 2.16.1. Function

**Python Call**

```python
ret = axcl.engine.run_sync(handle, io)
```

**C++ Prototype**

```cpp
AX_S32 AX_ENGINE_RunSync(AX_ENGINE_HANDLE handle, AX_ENGINE_IO_T* pIO);
```

#### 2.16.2. Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| handle | int &#124; None | Model handle. |
| io | dict &#124; None | Input IO descriptor. `inputs` and `outputs` are lists<br>    of buffer dictionaries; `input_size` and `output_size` are their counts.<br>    Buffer `phy_addr`/`vir_addr` are device addresses, not host allocation<br>    handles. Output tensor data is written to the referenced device buffers;<br>    the descriptor is not returned. The call is synchronous. |

#### 2.16.3. Returns

- `ret`: *int* — Success. Failure. Return error code.

#### 2.16.4. Note

Return type: `int`.

Source: `python/axcl/engine/ax_engine.py:1100`.

#### 2.16.5. Example

```python
ret = axcl.engine.run_sync(handle, io)
```
